custom_expected: Steps 3-4, 5-6, 7-8: Every user — including Administrator — can clock in and clock out via the universal control. All three actions are recorded in timesheets with correct user, role, and timestamp. Universal clock-in is NOT role-gated.
custom_preconds: Three active users: Administrator, Service Advisor, Time Clock User.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as Administrator.
2. Locate the universal clock in/out control.
3. Click Clock In.
4. Click Clock Out.
5. Log out. Log in as Service Advisor.
6. Repeat clock in / clock out.
7. Log out. Log in as Time Clock User.
8. Repeat clock in / clock out.
9. Verify all three timestamped entries appear in the timesheet records.
title: Universal clock in/out is available to ANY active staff record regardless of role
